name: flow_try_keeps_the_party
description: In a party on a server, Try from the Builders screen plays an offline practice match while the hub's connection lives on: the session keeps polling it, so its PINGs go out and the server (the fake sequencer, which closes a connection after 15 s of silence as the server does) keeps the row. After twenty seconds of practice, Play again leads back to the Builders screen on the same connection, in the same party with the same members.

steps.msg: Try: a solo practice match, offline
twenty seconds of practice and the server still hears the hub's connection (PING)

steps.assert: Session.party_size() == 2 and Session.client == link_before and Session.client.link.is_open()
steps.msg: the party and its connection live on during the practice
back from Try to the Builders screen, still on the server

steps.assert: Session.client == link_before and Session.party_code() == 'K7Q4M' and Session.party_size() == 2
steps.msg: in the same party, on the same connection
